scenarios.title: An off-contract status FAILS the test instead of skipping it

gherkin.given: a live open-knowledge no-ground turn returns an envelope whose status is not saved_as_idea and which carries no grounded sources
gherkin.when: the regression test evaluates the envelope
gherkin.then: the test reports a failure and does not report a skip

scenarios.title: A genuinely grounded turn still passes (non-tautology control)

gherkin.given: a live open-knowledge turn that the model grounded, whose envelope carries at least one source and capture_route false
gherkin.when: the regression test evaluates the envelope
gherkin.then: the test passes without asserting the capture acknowledgement and does not report a skip

scenarios.title: The SCOPE-074-04B canonical acknowledgement is still enforced

gherkin.given: a live open-knowledge no-ground turn that was captured
gherkin.when: the regression test evaluates the envelope
gherkin.then: capture_route is true, confirm_card and disambiguation_prompt are absent, and the body carries the canonical saved-as-idea acknowledgement

gherkin.given: the assistant HTTP adapter never binds and answers 503 assistant_http_not_ready
gherkin.then: the test may skip for infrastructure unavailability and no other condition in the test may skip

linkedTests.testId: static bailout scan (grep census of t.Skip vs t.Errorf/t.Fatalf)
